description: FlowFacade aims to enhance the intelligence of thermo-pneumatic passive shading systems by integrating soft pneumatic circuits and actuators into patented passive shading technology.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Affiliated with Eindhoven University of Technology

funding_summary: FlowFacade has received €150,000 in funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the Proof of Concept grant.
inflection_why_now: The increasing demand for sustainable architectural solutions and energy-efficient building designs presents a timely opportunity for FlowFacade's innovative approach to passive shading systems.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Feasibility: Integrating soft pneumatic circuits and actuators into existing passive shading systems may present engineering challenges.
Market Adoption: Convincing the construction industry to adopt new, unproven technologies could be challenging.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in advanced materials and chemicals, which could be synergistic with FlowFacade's focus on passive shading systems based on soft robotics and active materials.
WACKER is involved in the production of silicone-based materials, which could be relevant to the development of materials used in FlowFacade's shading systems.
